summary: Add a lifecycle block to the .tf file so the after_create event triggers an aap_eda_eventstream_post action; the example provisions an AWS EC2 RHEL 9 instance with aws ~> 6.0 and ansible/aap ~> 1.4.0, event stream username/password variables and an inventory lookup.
questions: How do I send an Event-Driven Ansible event after Terraform creates a server?
Which provider versions does the TF Actions EDA example use?
